hero.title: Empowering Every
hero.subtitle: Designed to support every aspect of your life - Physical, Mental, and Financial. Because true success begins with holistic wellbeing.

physical.title: Physical Wellness
physical.subtitle: Invest in your health with programs designed to energize, strengthen, and sustain your lifestyle.

modalDetails.fullDescription: Why settle for one gym when you can have them all? We’ve partnered with Cult.fit to give you an all-access pass to India’s premium fitness ecosystem. Whether you’re at home or traveling, your workout never skips a beat.
bulletPoints: Walk into any Cult center across the country—your membership travels with you
From high-intensity HRX and Boxing to Yoga and Dance, find the format that fuels your fire

modalDetails.fullDescription: FYERS Club Verse brings teams together through sports, wellness, and friendly competition. From tournaments to fitness activities, these events create opportunities to connect, collaborate, and stay active.
bulletPoints: Inter-team sports tournaments throughout the year
Fun wellness and fitness engagement activities
Opportunities to build team spirit and collaboration
Event announcements and updates shared on Zoho Connect and Zoho Cliq

modalDetails.fullDescription: Good nutrition fuels great performance. To make healthy eating easier and more convenient, FYERS provides nutritious weekday meals with a 50% subsidy.
bulletPoints: 50% meal subsidy sponsored by FYERS
Choice of veg and non-veg healthy meal options
Convenient pre-ordering through our partner app - Hunger Box
Available Monday to Friday
Nutritious meals with no maida or refined sugar, featuring millets and brown rice, along with calorie information for every meal
Member contribution adjusted in the monthly payroll cycle

benefits.title: Festive Menu
benefits.desc: Celebrate Cultures and Seasons Through Food.

modalDetails.fullDescription: Special festive menus are introduced throughout the year to celebrate the diverse cultures and seasons. These curated meals bring traditional flavors seasonal food from different regions, creating moments to experience and enjoy together.
bulletPoints: Special menus for major festivals and seasons
Traditional dishes inspired by festival cultures
Explore diverse seasonal cuisines
Encourages cultural connection and feast together

modalDetails.fullDescription: Through our partnership with Practo, members and their families can access verified doctors across multiple specialties anytime, anywhere.
bulletPoints: Unlimited online consultations for your family
Access to 24+ medical specialties
Audio, video, or chat consultation options
Connect with a doctor in under 5 minutes — 24/7
Coverage for up to 4 adults and 2 children
Veterinary consultations included
Up to 20% discount on medicines and lab tests
Up to 10% discount on clinic visits
Access to 1L+ doctors across India

benefits.title: Health Centre
benefits.desc: Stay on Top of Your Health.

modalDetails.fullDescription: Take proactive care of your well-being with access to health, eye, and dental check-ups available through Employee Health section on the Ethika portal. These services help ensure you and your insured dependents stay healthy and supported.
bulletPoints: Health check-ups for insured individuals
Eye check-up services
Dental check-up services
Easy access through fyers.ethika.in

benefits.title: Annual Health Camp
benefits.desc: Proactive Care for a Healthier You.

modalDetails.fullDescription: An annual preventive health camp is organized to help members stay ahead of potential health risks through early screenings and diagnostics. It’s an opportunity to check in on your health and take proactive steps toward long-term well-being.
bulletPoints: Company-organized annual preventive health camp
Access to health screenings and diagnostic tests
₹2,000 reimbursement for members outside bangalore locations
Participation is voluntary and confidential
Results are not linked to performance or promotion decisions

mental.title: Mental Wellness
mental.subtitle: Prioritize your inner balance and emotional resilience.

benefits.title: Comprehensive Leave Program
benefits.desc: Time Off That Supports Life Beyond Work.

modalDetails.fullDescription: Our leave policies are designed to give you the flexibility to rest, recharge, and take care of life’s important moments while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.
bulletPoints: Public Holiday Calendar
15 days Privilege Leave (carry forward up to 30 days)
12 days Sick Leave each year
Women’s Wellness Leave – 1 day per month
Birthday Leave – 1 paid day to celebrate you
Wedding Leave – 1 paid day
Maternity Leave – 26 weeks
Paternity / Adoption Leave – 15 days ( can be taken in within 6 months)
Bereavement Leave – up to 3 days annually
Compensatory Off for work on weekends or public holidays

modalDetails.fullDescription: Enjoy the flexibility to work remotely while staying connected and productive. The Work From Home benefit allows eligible members to manage personal commitments without missing a beat at work.
bulletPoints: Up to 4 Work From Home days per month
Requests submitted through the Zoho People - WFH & Leave module
WFH subjective to approval by your manager
WFH cannot be used as a substitute for leave or cannot be carried forward
Not applicable for Customer Success, Sales, Quality, and Facilities teams

modalDetails.fullDescription: Conscious Corner brings expert-led sessions focused on mental health awareness, emotional wellbeing, Physical and Financial best practices webinar by Industry experts helping members build resilience and maintain balance.
bulletPoints: Expert-led mental wellness webinar
Guidance on Physical, Financial and Mental well-being
Updates and resources shared on Zoho Connect

modalDetails.fullDescription: This initiative is designed to support women members experiencing menstrual discomfort or related health concerns, ensuring they have the flexibility and facilities needed for their wellbeing at work.
bulletPoints: 1 day paid Women’s Wellness Leave each month (12 days annually)
Available for women aged 18–52 years
Auto-approved leave with no medical documentation required
Easy application through the Zoho Leave module
Sanitary napkin dispensers and hygiene disposal bins in restrooms
Seat disinfectant spray provided in women’s restrooms
Hygienic facilities to support comfort and well-being

benefits.title: Grievance Redressal
benefits.desc: A Safe Space to Raise Concerns.

modalDetails.fullDescription: We are committed to maintaining a respectful and supportive workplace. Members can raise concerns or grievances through a structured and confidential process designed to ensure fair and timely resolution.
bulletPoints: Submit concerns via membergrievances@fyers.in
HR acknowledgement within 48 working hours
A structured and transparent resolution process
Escalation to HR leadership when required
Strict confidentiality maintained throughout

benefits.title: Harassment-Free Workplace
benefits.desc: A Culture of Respect and Safety.

modalDetails.fullDescription: We are committed to creating a workplace where every member feels safe, respected, and valued. Our policies ensure a professional environment built on dignity, inclusion, and mutual respect.
bulletPoints: Zero tolerance for harassment and discrimination
Full compliance with PoSH policy guidelines
Protection against Work place harassment
Ability to report concerns directly to reportsexualharassment@fyers.in
Complete policy details available on Zoho People

modalDetails.fullDescription: We believe achievements deserve recognition and moments of celebration. From milestone events to team outings, these activities bring members together and strengthen our collaborative culture.
bulletPoints: Milestone celebrations recognizing our contribution to add in customers.
Team outings and dinners to connect beyond work
Engaging team-building activities
Event updates and announcements shared on Zoho Connect

financial.title: Financial Wellness
financial.subtitle: Build security, stability, and long-term prosperity.

modalDetails.fullDescription: To support members and their families during medical emergencies, comprehensive Group Medical Insurance coverage is provided for hospitalization due to illness, disease, or injury.
bulletPoints: ₹5,00,000 medical insurance coverage per person and upto 30 lakhs medical insurance coverage per member
Coverage for members and eligible dependents
Protection against hospitalization expenses due to illness or injury
Cashless treatment at network hospitals
Accessible via the Ethika portal - fyers.ethika.in

modalDetails.fullDescription: This provides financial protection in the event of accidental injury, disability, or death, ensuring support for members and their families during unforeseen situations.
bulletPoints: ₹30,00,000 coverage for accidental death or disability
Coverage for permanent or partial disability due to accidents
Financial protection for members and their families
Coverage applicable as per policy terms and conditions

benefits.title: Group Term Insurance
benefits.desc: Financial Protection for Your Loved Ones.

modalDetails.fullDescription: To provide peace of mind and long-term security, Group Term Life Insurance ensures financial protection for your family in the event of unforeseen circumstances.
bulletPoints: 3× base salary coverage for career level 8 and below
5× base salary coverage for career level 9 and above
Financial protection and support for your dependents
Coverage applicable as per policy underwriting guidelines

benefits.title: Retirement Benefits
benefits.desc: Secure Your Future with Long-Term Savings.

modalDetails.fullDescription: Our retiral benefits are designed to help members build financial stability for the future while ensuring compliance with statutory requirements.
bulletPoints: Employer contribution towards EPF
Allocation to the Employee Pension Scheme (EPS)
EDLI life insurance coverage for added protection
Gratuity eligibility after 5 years of service
Statutory bonus as per the Code on Wages

modalDetails.fullDescription: Eligible members can opt for a company-supported car leasing program that offers flexibility and financial advantages while owning a vehicle.
bulletPoints: Available for career level 6 and above
Car price limit based on salary and lease tenure
Requires HR Head approval
Minimum CIBIL score of 700 required
A minimum CIBIL score of 700 is required to avail the benefit
Not applicable during Performance Improvement Programs or during probation

modalDetails.fullDescription: Employee State Insurance provides essential social security benefits that support members and their families during medical or financial emergencies.
bulletPoints: Employer contribution: 3.25%
Employee contribution: 0.75%
Contributions remitted within statutory timelines
Coverage includes medical, sickness, maternity, and disability benefits
Subjective to applicable members

benefits.title: Employee Referral Program
benefits.desc: Help Build the Team. Get Rewarded.

modalDetails.fullDescription: Know someone who would be a great fit? Refer talented candidates and earn exciting rewards when they successfully join the team.
bulletPoints: Up to ₹30,000 referral bonus for non-technical roles
Up to ₹60,000 referral bonus for technical roles
Rewards paid in two stages (3 months & 6 months)
Referrals submitted through Zoho Recruit

modalDetails.fullDescription: Balancing work and family is important. This benefit helps working parents manage childcare expenses with monthly creche reimbursements.
bulletPoints: Up to ₹8,000 per month per child
Applicable for children up to 6 years of age
Submit bills and birth certificate for reimbursement
Claims processed through Zoho Expense

modalDetails.fullDescription: Members are encouraged to enhance their professional skills through external courses, certifications, and conferences. This program helps support continuous learning and career development.
bulletPoints: Available after 6 months of service
Requires manager and department head approval
Final approval by HR & Management
Submit receipts and completion certificates via Zoho Expense

modalDetails.fullDescription: We organize fully funded learning opportunities to help members stay updated with the latest industry knowledge and skills.
bulletPoints: Sessions conducted by internal and external experts
Company-sponsored training programs like NISM
Easy access to modules to refer to on Zoho Learn

modalDetails.fullDescription: This award honors individuals who consistently deliver exceptional performance, demonstrate creativity, embody FYERS values, and make a significant impact on the organization’s growth.
bulletPoints: Rewards worth ₹1,00,000 (vouchers, cash, vacation, or equivalent options) & Recognition certificates for all winners
Recognition Frequency: Twice a year, October & April
Number of Winners: 2 winners per cycle & 4 winners in a financial year
Nomination Process: Any FYERS member can nominate another member (self-nominations not allowed)
Selection Process: Nominations reviewed by HR & Final selection by Founders & Leadership

modalDetails.fullDescription: This team award recognizes collaboration, innovation, and collective efforts that create meaningful impact and contribute to FYERS’ success.
bulletPoints: ₹1,50,000 worth team rewards which may include celebrations, vouchers, cash, giveaways, or team experiences & Recognition certificates for all team members
Recognition Frequency: Twice a year, October & April
Number of Winners: 2 winners per cycle & 4 winners in a financial year
Nomination Process: Any FYERS member can nominate another member (self-nominations not allowed)
Selection Process: Nominations reviewed by HR & Final selection by Founders & Leadership

modalDetails.fullDescription: SPOT Awards celebrate members who make exceptional contributions within a short time frame while demonstrating FYERS values and delivering meaningful results.
bulletPoints: Award Categories: FYERS Values Ambassador, FYERS Rising Star, FYERS Flash of Brilliance, FYERS Exceptional Team Player
₹5,000 gift vouchers & Recognition certificates for winners
Frequency: Awarded at the discretion of department heads and line managers
Nomination Process: Line managers recommend members with proper justification & Limited to 30% of team headcount per financial year
Selection Process: Final approval by Department Heads & Rewards issued by HR

benefits.title: Thank Anyone @ FYERS
benefits.desc: A Simple Way to Appreciate Each Other.

modalDetails.fullDescription: Gratitude goes a long way. This initiative encourages members to thank colleagues across the organization for their support, collaboration, and contributions.
bulletPoints: Members can thank anyone across FYERS anytime
Submit appreciation via Zoho People or the Thank Anyone @ FYERS
4 winners selected every quarter through a raffle draw
Winners receive ₹2,000 Amazon vouchers
